purpose: Scores an agent execution evidence bundle for underwriter-facing evidence completeness across four dimensions (determinism, replayability, oversight density, dispute history) using a version-pinned rubric selected by underwriter_profile: aiuc, aisure (Munich Re aiSure evidence-doc list), armilla (KPI-warranty dimensions), or generic (equal-weight union). Optional incident_history (shared incident_record schema) and reputation inputs are supported; self-asserted reputation is recorded but zero-weighted in the composite. This scores evidence completeness only, never an insurability decision, a reserve attestation, or an insurable/not-insurable verdict -- selling or underwriting insurance is out of scope. Zero network, zero PII.
